hero.headline: Making the internet slightly less annoying.

about.heading: 5+ years in, I’m faster at finding what matters, better at knowing what doesn’t, and still annoyingly picky about the details people actually notice.

projects.title: NowHealth — Brand and launch website for performance-focused health lab

servicesSection.heading: The stuff I do best
servicesSection.intro: Mostly websites. Sometimes apps, decks, and whatever else needs better taste and fewer unnecessary clicks.

items.title: Website Design
items.description: I design responsive websites from landing pages to full marketing sites, with a strong focus on layout, visual direction, interactions, and usability.

items.title: Design Engineering
items.description: I take designs further with interactive prototypes, motion, and AI-assisted workflows, so ideas can be tested and refined before they reach development.

items.title: Mobile App Design
items.description: I design mobile interfaces and user flows that are easy to understand, visually polished, and consistent across the full experience.

items.title: Pitch Deck Design
items.description: I turn raw content into clear, well-structured presentations with strong hierarchy, visual storytelling, and slides that are actually easy to follow.

items.title: Brand Collateral Design
items.description: I design business cards, banners, booklets, leaflets, and other print materials, keeping everything consistent with the existing brand and ready for production.

items.question: What kind of projects are you best at?
items.answer: Visual-heavy websites are where I do my best work. I also take on mobile UI, pitch decks, brand collateral, and design-engineering work when the project needs more than static screens.

items.question: Can you work with an existing team or design system?
items.answer: Absolutely. I’m comfortable joining an agency or remote team, picking up an existing system, and getting productive without needing everything explained ten times.

items.question: Do you only design, or do you also prototype and build?
items.answer: I like taking ideas further than Figma. Depending on the project, I’ll prototype interactions, test flows, and push the design closer to something real.

items.question: How do you use AI in your process?
items.answer: AI handles the busywork. I make coffee. Then I put the saved time into visual direction, UX decisions, and the details where taste and judgment actually matter.

items.question: Are you available for freelance, agency, or remote roles?
items.answer: Yes. I’m open to freelance projects, agency collaborations, and remote roles where I can contribute as a visual-first Design Engineer and stay close to both the design and the build.
